svg.aria-label: software-engineer: Release docs the PM, BA and QA can use. One sub-skill, release-docs: a template, a checker, a house PDF. Steps: Scope, what goes up, from release-scope; Evidence, a before and after shot per ticket; Decide, only the BA questions left open; Test plan, Expected Results QA can check; Check, check_report.py prints ok; Render, a cover, a page per section. Output: a release PDF for PM, BA and QA, with the staging test plan.
